title: slopvac v3 category
description: A group of rules, and the unit users enable, disable and score by. One category per file. Rule ids are unique within the category. Semantics are specified in docs/contract/rules.md. Owner: slopvac-8l4.2.3.

id.description: Category id. The qualified rule id is <plugin>:<category>.<rule>.

weight.description: Contribution to the overall score before any config override.

max_per_100_words.description: Density budget per profile, keyed by profile name. Absent means no budget. Profile semantics are owned by slopvac-8l4.2.10.
